scope: Practical DevOps curriculum, teaching progression, deployment/recovery lab design, bounded environment delivery, and Ascend integration.
status: Research and design only; no pack installed, external lab executed, repository created, or infrastructure provisioned.
method: Ordinary public first-party HTTP/documentation/syllabus review. No paid course attendance, signed-in platform audit, or independent validation of marketing outcomes.

sources.title: KodeKloud DevOps learning path
supports: Public path sequences foundations, scripting, Git, CI, containers, orchestration, automation, and observability.
Topic and role paths, hands-on challenges, and readiness checks are linked; logged-in Engineer task mechanics were not inspected.

sources.title: TechWorld with Nana: public DevOps syllabus
supports: Public syllabus combines manual build/package work with later integrated CI/CD, infrastructure, container, and monitoring projects.
Employment and income claims in the marketing page were not independently validated.

sources.title: Killercoda environments and membership
supports: Interactive Linux/Kubernetes scenarios are accessed in a browser.
The page explicitly says interactive environments use VMs for stronger isolation; finite session and concurrency allowances vary by membership.

sources.title: Killercoda creator documentation
supports: Scenarios are Git-based and synchronise on push.
Step definitions can use verification scripts triggered by CHECK; this does not establish tamper-proof independent learner evidence.

sources.title: Docker: build and share a containerized application; redirects to current tutorial
supports: Tutorial progresses through running an image, Compose, building, publishing, and cleanup.
It distinguishes images from containers and lists account/tool prerequisites.

sources.title: GitHub Skills: Hello GitHub Actions
supports: Exercise explicitly states audience, prerequisites, expected output, and steps for a workflow in a learner-owned repository.
Public/private visibility and Actions usage are relevant account requirements.

sources.title: GitHub Skills: Test with Actions
supports: Exercise teaches a test workflow, a failed test, and enforcing passing checks before merging.

sources.title: GitHub Skills: Publish Docker Images
supports: Exercise teaches building/publishing Docker images to GitHub Container Registry and versioning through changes, pull requests, and releases.

sources.title: GitHub: deployment environments; redirects to current documentation
supports: Deployment environments can have protection rules and environment secrets.
Available protections depend on repository visibility and product plan.

sources.title: GitHub: OpenID Connect; redirects to current documentation
supports: OIDC exchanges short-lived tokens with a cloud provider and requires a configured trust relationship and workflow permissions.

sources.title: Kubernetes Basics
supports: Kubernetes Basics presents background plus modules to create, deploy, explore, expose, scale, and update an application.
Actual practice-cluster setup is a separate prerequisite.

sources.title: kind Quick Start
supports: kind supplies a local Kubernetes cluster workflow with explicit cluster creation and deletion.

sources.title: Terraform: Docker getting-started tutorials
supports: The Docker getting-started path teaches build, change, and destroy operations plus variables, outputs, and state concepts.

sources.title: OpenTofu introduction and workflow
supports: OpenTofu documents write, plan, apply, provider APIs, resource dependencies, state, and reusable configurations.

sources.title: Ansible: getting started; redirects to current documentation
supports: Ansible introduces a control node, inventory, managed nodes, and playbooks.

sources.title: First steps with Prometheus
supports: Prometheus first steps uses configuration, scrape targets, and queries rather than only a dashboard screenshot.

sources.title: Google SRE Workbook: Implementing SLOs
supports: SLO guidance connects specific measurable indicators and time windows to reliability/engineering decisions.

sources.title: Google SRE Workbook: Incident Response
supports: Incident response guidance covers practiced coordination, recovery, and learning through postmortems.
